android.desc:
Epic Card Game is a fast paced card game of fantasy combat designed by Hall of Fame Magic players Rob Dougherty and Darwin Kastle. Get all the amazing game play and beautiful art of a trading card game, without  the cost of a one!

Epic Card Game is a strategy card game, where you summon champions and use events to try and defeat your opponent. There are many ways to play Epic – a different game every time you play! Supported in the app are Sealed, Dark Draft, Preconstructed, and Full Constructed. There is also Campaign mode, where you try to defeat as many opponents as possible, all while building a better and better deck of cards as you progress through the Epic landscape. For more formats, check out the physical game that the app was based on.

In this card game, there are no random rewards or hard-to-get cards. When you buy the full version of the game, you get everything you need to play. You know exactly what cards you’re getting. There are expansions, but they are optional. You can play and enjoy hundreds of games with just the base set!
